recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast black and white portrait of a man in a cowboy hat standing in a rural street at dusk, featuring textured, weathered typography at the top and a bokeh-effect line of streetlights in the background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a vast, open sky
Textural harmony between the distressed font and the grain of the film
Linear perspective created by the receding streetlights on the right
Contrast between the dark silhouette of the hat and the lighter sky
coreInvariants: Wide-brimmed cowboy hat as a silhouette anchor

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and the brim of the cowboy hat.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large display text, moves down to the subject's face, then follows the line of streetlights into the background depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant open sky in the upper half provides a clean canvas for typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Mid-tone grays in the sky and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks in the shadows and hat silhouette.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white highlights in the streetlights and text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value contrast between the subject and the sky.

letterConstructionRules: Distressed, chalky, or weathered texture applied to the fill
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'S' has a wide, open curve
The letter 'E' features equal-length horizontal bars

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the negative space of the sky

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A textured, heavy display font paired with a clean, ultra-wide tracked secondary font for a modern-rustic feel.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric skeleton and rounded terminals.
Provides the industrial but soft-edged look.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A black and white photograph of a man in a cowboy hat and t-shirt, hands in pockets, standing on a rural road at twilight. A line of glowing streetlights recedes into the distance on the right. High film grain, cinematic lighting, vast gray sky above.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered uppercase text in the upper third of the image. The top line should be large, rounded sans-serif with a weathered chalk texture. The second line should be smaller, thin, with extremely wide letter spacing.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly black and white?
Is the film grain visible and consistent?
Is the tracking on the subtitle text significantly wider than the display text?
Are the terminals of the main text rounded?

adjustableVariables: Amount of weathering on the text
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or titles
postGenerationChecks: Check for haloing around the subject's head
Ensure the text texture doesn't make it illegible
Verify the perspective of the streetlights feels natural
Confirm the grayscale range includes true blacks and whites
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome + Low-Angle Portrait + Weathered Rounded Sans-Serif + Wide Tracking Subtitle + Film Grain
